tunables.label: Server Port
tunables.description: Internal unprivileged container listening port for Nginx.
tunables.troubleshooting: Platform base image runs unprivileged on port 8080.

tunables.label: Workload Role
tunables.description: Execution mode for the container inside Kubernetes.
tunables.troubleshooting: Set to 'worker' for queue workers, 'horizon' for Redis Horizon, and 'scheduler' for cron artisan schedule without needing separate Dockerfiles.

tunables.label: Script Memory Limit
tunables.description: Maximum amount of memory a single PHP script may consume.
tunables.troubleshooting: Increase to 512M if processes fail with 'Allowed memory size exhausted'.

tunables.label: Max Upload Size
tunables.description: Maximum allowed size for uploaded files in PHP.
tunables.troubleshooting: If your application returns HTTP 413 Payload Too Large, increase this value alongside PHP_POST_MAX_SIZE.

tunables.label: Max POST Body Size
tunables.description: Maximum size of POST data that PHP will accept.
tunables.troubleshooting: This must be greater than or equal to PHP_UPLOAD_MAX_FILESIZE.

tunables.label: Max Execution Time
tunables.description: Maximum execution time in seconds for PHP scripts.
tunables.troubleshooting: Increase this if long-running requests or migrations timeout.

tunables.label: PHP Timezone
tunables.troubleshooting: Must be a valid IANA timezone identifier, e.g. 'Asia/Jakarta' or 'UTC'.

tunables.label: Storage Symlink
tunables.description: Runs 'php artisan storage:link' on container startup if missing.
tunables.troubleshooting: Ensure public storage is linked to allow public uploads access.

tunables.label: Run Migrations on Boot
tunables.description: Runs 'php artisan migrate --force' automatically on startup.
tunables.troubleshooting: Recommended only for initial deploy or single-replica instances.

tunables.label: Run Optimize on Boot
tunables.description: Runs 'php artisan optimize' on container startup.
tunables.troubleshooting: Caches routes, config, and views for production performance.

tunables.label: Queue Connection
tunables.description: Queue connection name processed by workers (e.g. 'redis', 'database').

tunables.label: Queue Names
tunables.description: Comma-separated list of queues to process (e.g. 'high,default,low').

tunables.label: Queue Worker Processes
tunables.description: Number of parallel worker processes spawned by Supervisor in 'worker' role.

tunables.label: Queue Job Timeout
tunables.description: Maximum seconds a single queue job may run before timeout.
